reviews.title: Allows me to create professional videos.
reviews.pros:
Synthesia is very easy to use, even for non-technical users. Users can create videos by writing their script, choosing an avatar, selecting a background, and adding text and images. Users can also upload their own slideshows or screen recordings to enhance their videos.

It has a diverse and realistic selection of avatars, voices, and accents. Users can choose from more than 30 avatars with different genders, ethnicities, and styles. Users can also select from more than 65 languages and 100 voices with different accents and tones. Avatars are lip-synced and have realistic facial expressions that match the voice and script.

It's very efficient and cost-effective, I can create high-quality videos in minutes, without the need for cameras, actors, or editing software. Users can also edit or update their videos at any time, without having to reshoot or reshoot.

Synthesia is very versatile and adaptable. Users can create videos for various purposes such as learning, support, sales, or marketing. Users can also customize their videos to suit their target audience by changing the avatar's appearance, voice, language, or background. Synthesia also provides ready-to-use examples for different use cases that users can modify or replicate.
reviews.cons:
It has some limitations and disadvantages. Users can only create videos up to 10 minutes in length, which may not be enough for some topics or audiences. Users may only use avatars provided by Synthesia, which may not match their brand identity or personal preference. Users may also encounter some issues with voice quality, pronunciation, or inflection of some languages or words.

It has some room for improvement and development, users may want more features or options to enhance their videos, such as more templates, backgrounds, animations, transitions, music, or sound effects. Users may also want more control over the speed, pitch, or emotion of the voice. Users may also want more feedback or support from the Synthesia team or community.
reviews.overall: Within this excellent tool you can create engaging and professional-looking videos with AI avatars and text-to-speech technology. It is easy to use, efficient, cost effective, versatile and adaptable. It has a lot of potential and value for various users and use cases. However, it also has some limitations and drawbacks that may affect your performance or satisfaction. It also has some room for improvement and development that may improve its functionality or quality. Overall, I would recommend Synthesia to anyone looking for a simple and innovative way to create videos with AI avatars.
